name: Reel map
summary: A trip reel pulled apart into its spots and pinned on a drawn city map; friends tap the spots they want, the route draws itself through the ones enough people picked, and the weekend goes to a vote.
useWhen: we need to do this exact trip (someone shared a city reel)
this reel has like 5 spots, which ones are we actually doing
can we plan a weekend off this tiktok of montreal
map out the places from that reel and see who wants what
turn the travel reel into an actual route
dontUseWhen: a single hike or one activity from a reel (use reel-hike-plan or reel-to-try)
locking dates and costs for a trip already decided (use trip-lock)
drafting who plans which part of the trip (use trip-draft)

quote.description: What they said when sharing it

spots.description: 3 to 6 spots in the order the reel visits them

kind.description: Drawing: bread, park, storefront, book, coffee, curry, ramen, pizza, venue, campus and the other thumb kinds

x.description: Left to right on the map, 100 to 900

y.description: Top to bottom on the map, 120 to 800

weekend.description: The dates that go to a vote
